d: Contribute to the review, update and enhancements of ER policies and procedures of Nakilat. Perform day to day employee relations services, in accordance with the applicable policies and procedures.
Propose and participate in improvements related to ERP and other ER implemented system.
q: Diploma in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
4 – 6 years of related experience in a similar position, preferably in a similar industry.
Knowledge of HR-ERP systems, preferably SAP
Knowledge of HR policies and procedures
r: Maintain all employees’ information, records, and documents in the system, while ensuring up to date and accurate data entry.
Process all changes related to employees’ status, remuneration, and organizational assignments in a timely manner.
Review, validate, and process requests raised related to employee relations services on time and as per the applicable policies and procedures.
Maintain and update employees’ files while ensuring their confidentiality.
Respond to employees' inquiries related to employee relations policies and procedures.
Prepare memos, letters and employment agreement as needed.
Assist in communicating and circulating new/updated policies, procedures, and regulations to Nakilat employees.
Assist in new employees’ mobilization by making necessary arrangements such as hotel booking, travel arrangements, temporary hotel booking.
Coordinate with the Finance Payroll team to conduct payroll activities, for monthly salaries, ad hoc allowances, and benefits for all employees
Attend internal and external audits, and prepare responses and actions as needed for audit reports.
Process purchase requisitions, service entries and vendor payments, related to Employee Relations activities.
Coordinate with employees and Health Insurance providers for matters related to employees’ entitlement, claims and applicable coverage.
Coordinate with Insurance Department and Group Life Insurance / Workmen Compensation vendors, to provide reports and information for establishing and/or renewal of agreements.
Generate several reports, such as KPI, trends, analytic, customized report, requested by HR Sections and/or Departments.
Propose enhancements on ER systems and coordinate with IT development team, on configuration and testing of solutions configured by IT.

Perform complete separation/demobilization activities for separated employees, including preparation of final settlement calculation and documents, attending exit interviews, travel arrangements, etc.

d: An UHNW private family in Dubai is seeking a qualified and experienced Private Nurse with a strong background in newborn care and maternity or postnatal nursing. Midwifery qualifications or experience are highly preferred. The successful candidate will provide professional, attentive and discreet care for the newborn and support the mother during the postnatal period.
q: Recognized nursing qualification with relevant professional registration or licensing, as applicable.
At least 5 years of relevant experience in newborn care, maternity nursing or postnatal care. Midwifery qualification or practical midwifery experience highly preferred.
Strong knowledge of infant feeding, hygiene, newborn safety and safe-sleep practices.
Infant CPR and first-aid certification preferred.
Professional, compassionate, reliable and discreet, with sound judgement.
Previous private household or UHNW family experience is an advantage.
Professional references and appropriate background checks required.
r: Provide daily care for the newborn, ensuring comfort, hygiene and safety.
Monitor feeding, sleeping patterns and general well-being.
Support breastfeeding, bottle feeding and appropriate feeding routines.
Maintain hygiene and sterilization of feeding equipment and baby-care items.
Support the mother during the postnatal period within the scope of professional qualifications.
Recognize signs of illness or distress and coordinate with healthcare professionals when required.
Maintain accurate care records and protect the family's privacy.
Work collaboratively with the family and household staff.
x: Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.
Employment visa sponsorship and medical insurance.
Paid annual leave in accordance with applicable UAE law and agreed employment terms.
Annual return flight or travel allowance.
